dataset.name: WANDS 2 real tenants: Rugs (quiet/low-churn, from H2/P7-E00), Furniture (high-churn, repeatedly rebuilt)

engine_config.native: commerce_core::index::CatalogIndex, quiet tenant queried while a separate thread continuously rebuilds and hot-swaps the churn tenant's index via Mutex<Arc<CatalogIndex>>

headline_result.h14_status: FALSIFIED, reproduced across 3 runs -- a genuine material effect, unlike H2's null result for pure query load
headline_result.comparison_to_h13_query_cost: ~100x a single facet-scan query's own CPU cost
headline_result.disclosed_unconfirmed_mechanism: CPU-core contention between the churn thread and quiet-tenant query thread on this 4-core container -- not profiled or confirmed
headline_result.named_limitation: only 5 discrete rebuild events per 5s run; only one churn tenant size (largest) and one quiet tenant tested
